this is good, now, we need to add doors, now there can be as much doors as you want, but doors require a 1 tile hallway, but it doesnt need indents, you can just put walls on the way down, make sure every door has stairs behind it, ascending or descending doesnt matter. So you can add as much door hallways as you want, but you ahve to decide for one of them which door we enter from, for example when the game is ready for production, we have to connect all the rooms generated together, so if a player enters from one room into the new one, one door has to be the one we entered from, and it has to be open. Doors are overlays, there are 2 door directions, theres one for the top and bottom, (doesnt matter perspective if we make the 1 tile hallways for them,), and we have the ones for the left and right, and then for each direction is open and close.
I added the pngs for it in the root for you to use. How to make these hallways is make the 1 tile hallways 4 tiles deep, make the door be 2 tiles in the hallway, and then 1 tile behind the door, then after that tile should be the stairs.
